verdict.rationale:
Docs explicitly describe `git clone` + `mise bootstrap` (or `mise install`) as the one-command path to set up an entire fresh machine — tools, packages, dotfiles, services, and env vars — replacing manual per-language installers, and community reviews corroborate the reproducible, low-friction onboarding experience (e.g. 'so much easier for new people to get started without a bunch of manual steps'). Lockfiles plus `mise install --locked` further reinforce reproducibility guarantees.
missing for 10: no independent hands-on walkthrough of `mise bootstrap` on a truly fresh machine confirming all declared components install correctly, and some skepticism about task-runner completeness in CI exists.
